<!DOCTYPE html>
<html lang="he" dir="rtl">
<head>
<meta charset="UTF-8">
<meta name="viewport" content="width=device-width, initial-scale=1.0, maximum-scale=1.0, user-scalable=no, viewport-fit=cover">
<meta name="apple-mobile-web-app-capable" content="yes">
<meta name="apple-mobile-web-app-status-bar-style" content="default">
<meta name="apple-mobile-web-app-title" content="תכנון שיעור">
<meta name="mobile-web-app-capable" content="yes">
<meta name="theme-color" content="#6BBFCF">
<title>תכנון שיעור</title>
<style>
@import url('https://fonts.googleapis.com/css2?family=Heebo:wght@400;700;900&display=swap');
*,*::before,*::after{box-sizing:border-box;margin:0;padding:0;-webkit-tap-highlight-color:transparent;}
html{height:100%;}
body{font-family:'Heebo',Arial,sans-serif;direction:rtl;background:#f7f7f5;min-height:100%;-webkit-font-smoothing:antialiased;-webkit-text-size-adjust:100%;overscroll-behavior:none;}
#app{max-width:680px;margin:0 auto;padding:12px 14px max(60px,env(safe-area-inset-bottom,60px));}
.header{text-align:center;padding:14px 0 12px;margin-bottom:14px;border-bottom:2px solid #e8e8e8;}
.logo-img{height:68px;object-fit:contain;display:block;margin:0 auto 6px;}
.header h1{font-size:22px;font-weight:700;color:#333;}
.steps-bar{display:flex;align-items:center;justify-content:center;gap:0;margin-bottom:18px;}
.step-wrap{display:flex;flex-direction:column;align-items:center;}
.step-circle{width:34px;height:34px;border-radius:50%;display:flex;align-items:center;justify-content:center;font-size:14px;font-weight:700;border:2px solid #ccc;background:#fff;color:#aaa;transition:background .2s,border-color .2s;}
.step-circle.active{background:#6BBFCF;border-color:#6BBFCF;color:#fff;}
.step-circle.done{background:#C8EFD4;border-color:#7ABF8E;color:#3a7a4a;}
.step-label{font-size:11px;color:#aaa;margin-top:3px;text-align:center;width:70px;}
.step-label.active{color:#6BBFCF;font-weight:700;}
.step-label.done{color:#7ABF8E;}
.step-line{height:2px;width:24px;background:#ddd;flex-shrink:0;margin-bottom:16px;}
.step-line.done{background:#7ABF8E;}
.card{background:#fff;border-radius:16px;padding:18px 16px;margin-bottom:14px;box-shadow:0 2px 8px rgba(0,0,0,.08);}
.sec-title{font-size:16px;font-weight:700;color:#333;margin-bottom:4px;}
.sec-desc{font-size:13px;color:#888;margin-bottom:14px;}
.badge{font-size:12px;background:#6BBFCF;color:#fff;border-radius:12px;padding:2px 9px;margin-right:6px;}
.grid-2{display:grid;grid-template-columns:1fr 1fr;gap:10px;}
.pick-btn{position:relative;display:flex;flex-direction:column;align-items:center;gap:6px;padding:14px 8px 12px;border:2px solid #e0e0e0;border-radius:12px;background:#fff;cursor:pointer;min-height:100px;transition:border-color .15s,background .15s;outline:none;-webkit-appearance:none;touch-action:manipulation;}
.pick-btn:active{opacity:.82;}
.pick-btn.sel{border-color:#6BBFCF;background:#EAF6FA;}
.pick-btn img{width:54px;height:54px;object-fit:contain;display:block;}
.pick-btn .plbl{font-size:12px;color:#444;text-align:center;line-height:1.3;}
.tick-badge{position:absolute;top:6px;left:6px;width:20px;height:20px;border-radius:50%;background:#6BBFCF;color:#fff;font-size:12px;font-weight:700;display:flex;align-items:center;justify-content:center;}
.act-item{display:flex;align-items:center;gap:10px;padding:12px;border:2px solid #e0e0e0;border-radius:12px;margin-bottom:8px;background:#fff;transition:border-color .15s,background .15s;cursor:pointer;touch-action:manipulation;outline:none;-webkit-appearance:none;min-height:56px;}
.act-item:active{opacity:.82;}
.act-item.sel{border-color:#6BBFCF;background:#EAF6FA;}
.act-item.dis{opacity:.38;cursor:default;pointer-events:none;}
.act-item img.icon{width:40px;height:40px;object-fit:contain;flex-shrink:0;}
.act-name{font-size:14px;color:#333;flex:1;}
.mode-wrap{display:flex;gap:6px;flex-shrink:0;}
.mbtn{display:flex;align-items:center;gap:4px;padding:6px 10px;border:1.5px solid #ccc;border-radius:20px;background:#fff;color:#888;font-size:12px;cursor:pointer;white-space:nowrap;transition:background .15s,border-color .15s;touch-action:manipulation;outline:none;-webkit-appearance:none;min-height:36px;font-family:'Heebo',Arial,sans-serif;}
.mbtn img{width:18px;height:18px;object-fit:contain;}
.mbtn:active{opacity:.8;}
.mbtn.ms{border-color:#6BBFCF;background:#d4eef7;color:#2a7a9a;font-weight:700;}
.act-check{width:22px;height:22px;border-radius:50%;background:#6BBFCF;color:#fff;font-size:13px;font-weight:700;display:flex;align-items:center;justify-content:center;flex-shrink:0;}
.nav-row{display:flex;gap:10px;justify-content:space-between;margin-top:16px;}
.btn{padding:13px 22px;border-radius:12px;font-size:14px;font-weight:700;cursor:pointer;touch-action:manipulation;outline:none;-webkit-appearance:none;appearance:none;font-family:'Heebo',Arial,sans-serif;border:none;transition:opacity .15s;min-height:48px;}
.btn:active{opacity:.8;}
.btn-back{background:#f0f0f0;color:#666;border:1.5px solid #ddd;}
.btn-next{background:#6BBFCF;color:#fff;}
.btn-next:disabled{opacity:.38;pointer-events:none;}
.btn-reset{background:#f0f0f0;color:#666;border:1.5px solid #ddd;}
.board-title{font-size:22px;font-weight:900;color:#2E6FA8;text-align:center;margin-bottom:6px;}
.board-hint{text-align:center;font-size:12px;color:#bbb;margin-bottom:14px;}
.brow{position:relative;border-radius:14px;overflow:hidden;margin-bottom:10px;cursor:pointer;touch-action:manipulation;-webkit-tap-highlight-color:transparent;min-height:80px;}
.brow-bg{position:absolute;inset:0;background-size:100% 100%;background-repeat:no-repeat;}
.brow-inner{position:relative;display:flex;flex-direction:column;align-items:center;padding:12px 14px;gap:8px;}
.brow-label{font-size:20px;font-weight:700;color:#333;text-align:center;line-height:1.4;}
.brow-icons{display:flex;gap:12px;flex-wrap:wrap;align-items:center;justify-content:center;width:100%;}
.brow-icons img{width:72px;height:72px;object-fit:contain;}
.brow-mode{display:inline-flex;align-items:center;gap:5px;font-size:12px;color:#555;background:rgba(255,255,255,.25);padding:4px 10px;border-radius:12px;}
.brow-mode img{width:24px;height:24px;object-fit:contain;}
.done-ov{position:absolute;inset:0;border-radius:14px;background:rgba(255,255,255,.55);display:flex;align-items:center;justify-content:center;font-size:60px;opacity:0;transition:opacity .2s;pointer-events:none;}
.brow.checked .done-ov{opacity:1;}
.brow.checked .brow-bg{filter:brightness(.88);}
.footer{text-align:center;font-size:12px;color:#aaa;padding:18px 0 8px;line-height:1.6;}
</style>
</head>
<body>
<div id="app">
  <div class="header">
    <img class="logo-img" id="logoImg" alt="לוגו">
    <h1>תכנון שיעור</h1>
  </div>
  <div class="steps-bar" id="stepsBar"></div>
  <div id="content"></div>
  <div class="footer">עיצוב ועריכה: הדר חלפון<br>צוות טכנופדגוגיה מתי״א יבנה</div>
</div>
<script>
const IMGS = {
  "סיכום_ופרידה": "data:image/png;base64,",
  "רצף_מספרים": "data:image/png;base64,",
  "דף_עבודה": "data:image/png;base64,",
  "סיפור": "data:image/png;base64,",
  "שיר": "data:image/png;base64,",
  "ימי_השבוע": "data:image/png;base64,",
  "רצף_אותיות": "data:image/png;base64,",
  "צבעים": "data:image/png;base64,",
  "משחק_תנועה": "data:image/png;base64,",
  "משחק_קלפים": "data:image/png;base64,",
  "פאזל": "data:image/png;base64,",
  "משחק_קופסה": "data:image/png;base64,",
  "קבוצה_מליאה": "data:image/png;base64,",
  "בצק": "data:image/png;base64,",
  "שיחה": "data:image/png;base64,",
  "מחשב_אייפד": "data:image/png;base64,",
  "גזירה_צביעה": "data:image/png;base64,",
  "יצירה": "data:image/png;base64,",
  "חצר": "data:image/png;base64,",
  "רקע1": "data:image/png;base64,",
  "רקע2": "data:image/png;base64,",
  "רקע3": "data:image/png;base64,",
  "רקע4": "data:image/png;base64,",
  "רקע5": "data:image/png;base64,",
  "מספר1": "data:image/png;base64,",
  "מספר2": "data:image/png;base64,",
  "מספר3": "data:image/png;base64,",
  "מספר4": "data:image/png;base64,",
  "מספר5": "data:image/png;base64,",
  "לוגו": "data:image/png;base64,",
  "פרטני": "data:image/png;base64,",
};

document.getElementById('logoImg').src=IMGS['לוגו']||'';
const OPENING_ITEMS=[{name:'רצף המספרים',key:'רצף_מספרים'},{name:'רצף האותיות',key:'רצף_אותיות'},{name:'ימי השבוע',key:'ימי_השבוע'},{name:'לוח צבעים',key:'צבעים'},{name:'שיר',key:'שיר'},{name:'שיחה',key:'שיחה'}];
const ACT_ITEMS=[{name:'פעילות בשפה',key:'רצף_אותיות'},{name:'פעילות בחשבון',key:'רצף_מספרים'},{name:'פעילות עם צבעים',key:'צבעים'},{name:'משחק קופסה/שולחן',key:'משחק_קופסה'},{name:'משחק קלפים',key:'משחק_קלפים'},{name:'פאזל',key:'פאזל'},{name:'בצק',key:'בצק'},{name:'יצירה',key:'יצירה'},{name:'גזירה / צביעה',key:'גזירה_צביעה'},{name:'דף עבודה',key:'דף_עבודה'},{name:'מחשב / אייפד',key:'מחשב_אייפד'},{name:'משחק בתנועה',key:'משחק_תנועה'},{name:'שיר',key:'שיר'},{name:'סיפור',key:'סיפור'},{name:'שיחה',key:'שיחה'},{name:'חצר',key:'חצר'}];
const SUMMARY={name:'סיכום ופרידה',key:'סיכום_ופרידה'};
const STEP_LABELS=['פתיחה','פעילויות','רצף השיעור'];
const BG_KEYS=['רקע1','רקע3','רקע2','רקע4','רקע5'];
const BG_COLORS=['#B8DCEE','#B8EADC','#B8EEE8','#DBBCEE','#EEB8D4'];
var plan={step:1,opening:[],acts:[],modes:{},checked:{}};
function mkImg(key,w,h){return '<img src="'+(IMGS[key]||'')+'" width="'+w+'" height="'+h+'" style="object-fit:contain;" loading="lazy">';}
function modeImg(key,size){return '<img src="'+(IMGS[key]||'')+'" style="width:'+size+'px;height:'+size+'px;object-fit:contain;vertical-align:middle;">';}
function drawSteps(){var bar=document.getElementById('stepsBar');bar.innerHTML='';for(var n=1;n<=3;n++){var wrap=document.createElement('div');wrap.className='step-wrap';var circ=document.createElement('div');circ.className='step-circle'+(plan.step===n?' active':plan.step>n?' done':'');circ.textContent=plan.step>n?'✓':n;var lbl=document.createElement('div');lbl.className='step-label'+(plan.step===n?' active':plan.step>n?' done':'');lbl.textContent=STEP_LABELS[n-1];wrap.appendChild(circ);wrap.appendChild(lbl);bar.appendChild(wrap);if(n<3){var line=document.createElement('div');line.className='step-line'+(plan.step>n?' done':'');line.style.marginBottom='16px';bar.appendChild(line);}}}
function drawStep1(){var html='<div class="card"><div class="sec-title">פתיחת השיעור</div><div class="sec-desc">בחרי אחד או יותר מרכיבי פתיחה:</div><div class="grid-2">';OPENING_ITEMS.forEach(function(o,i){var sel=plan.opening.indexOf(i)>-1;html+='<button type="button" class="pick-btn'+(sel?' sel':'')+'" data-oi="'+i+'">'+(sel?'<div class="tick-badge">✓</div>':'')+mkImg(o.key,54,54)+'<span class="plbl">'+o.name+'</span></button>';});html+='</div></div><div class="nav-row"><span></span><button type="button" class="btn btn-next" id="btnNext1">המשך לפעילויות ←</button></div>';document.getElementById('content').innerHTML=html;document.querySelectorAll('.pick-btn').forEach(function(btn){btn.addEventListener('touchend',function(e){e.preventDefault();handleO(this);},{passive:false});btn.addEventListener('click',function(){handleO(this);});});document.getElementById('btnNext1').addEventListener('touchend',function(e){e.preventDefault();goStep(2);},{passive:false});document.getElementById('btnNext1').addEventListener('click',function(){goStep(2);});}
function handleO(btn){var i=parseInt(btn.getAttribute('data-oi'));var idx=plan.opening.indexOf(i);if(idx>-1)plan.opening.splice(idx,1);else plan.opening.push(i);drawStep1();}
function drawStep2(){var cnt=plan.acts.length;var html='<div class="card"><div class="sec-title">פעילויות <span class="badge">'+cnt+'/3</span></div><div class="sec-desc">בחרי עד 3 פעילויות ואפייני כל אחת:</div>';ACT_ITEMS.forEach(function(a,i){var sel=plan.acts.indexOf(i)>-1;var dis=!sel&&cnt>=3;var m=plan.modes[i]||'';html+='<div class="act-item'+(sel?' sel':'')+(dis?' dis':'')+'" data-ai="'+i+'">'+mkImg(a.key,40,40)+'<span class="act-name">'+a.name+'</span>';if(sel){html+='<div class="mode-wrap"><button type="button" class="mbtn'+(m==='פרטני'?' ms':'')+'" data-ai="'+i+'" data-mode="פרטני">'+modeImg('פרטני',18)+' פרטני</button><button type="button" class="mbtn'+(m==='קבוצתי'?' ms':'')+'" data-ai="'+i+'" data-mode="קבוצתי">'+modeImg('קבוצה_מליאה',18)+' קבוצתי</button></div><div class="act-check">✓</div>';}html+='</div>';});if(cnt>=3)html+='<div style="text-align:center;font-size:12px;color:#6BBFCF;margin-top:4px;">הגעת למקסימום 3 פעילויות</div>';html+='</div><div class="nav-row"><button type="button" class="btn btn-back" id="btnBack2">→ חזרה</button><button type="button" class="btn btn-next" id="btnNext2"'+(cnt<1?' disabled':'')+'>רצף השיעור ←</button></div>';document.getElementById('content').innerHTML=html;document.querySelectorAll('.act-item').forEach(function(row){function handler(e){if(e.type==='touchend')e.preventDefault();if(e.target.classList.contains('mbtn')||e.target.closest('.mbtn'))return;if(row.classList.contains('dis'))return;var i=parseInt(row.getAttribute('data-ai'));var idx=plan.acts.indexOf(i);if(idx>-1){plan.acts.splice(idx,1);delete plan.modes[i];}else if(plan.acts.length<3)plan.acts.push(i);drawStep2();}row.addEventListener('touchend',handler,{passive:false});row.addEventListener('click',handler);});document.querySelectorAll('.mbtn').forEach(function(btn){function mHandler(e){if(e.type==='touchend')e.preventDefault();e.stopPropagation();plan.modes[parseInt(btn.getAttribute('data-ai'))]=btn.getAttribute('data-mode');drawStep2();}btn.addEventListener('touchend',mHandler,{passive:false});btn.addEventListener('click',mHandler);});document.getElementById('btnBack2').addEventListener('touchend',function(e){e.preventDefault();goStep(1);},{passive:false});document.getElementById('btnBack2').addEventListener('click',function(){goStep(1);});document.getElementById('btnNext2').addEventListener('touchend',function(e){e.preventDefault();if(plan.acts.length>0)goStep(3);},{passive:false});document.getElementById('btnNext2').addEventListener('click',function(){if(plan.acts.length>0)goStep(3);});}
function drawStep3(){var html='<div class="card" style="background:transparent;box-shadow:none;padding:0;"><div class="board-title">רצף השיעור</div><div class="board-hint">לחצי על כל שלב לסימון ✓</div>';for(var slot=0;slot<5;slot++){var bgKey=BG_KEYS[slot];var bgColor=BG_COLORS[slot];var chk=plan.checked[slot]||false;var inner='';if(slot===0){inner='<div class="brow-inner"><div class="brow-label">פתיחה</div>';if(plan.opening.length>0){inner+='<div class="brow-icons">'+plan.opening.map(function(oi){return mkImg(OPENING_ITEMS[oi].key,72,72);}).join('')+'</div>';}inner+='</div>';}else if(slot===4){inner='<div class="brow-inner"><div class="brow-label">'+SUMMARY.name+'</div><div class="brow-icons">'+mkImg(SUMMARY.key,72,72)+'</div></div>';}else{var actIdx=slot-1;if(actIdx<plan.acts.length){var a=ACT_ITEMS[plan.acts[actIdx]];var m=plan.modes[plan.acts[actIdx]]||'';var modeHtml=m?'<span class="brow-mode">'+(m==='פרטני'?modeImg('פרטני',24)+' פרטני':modeImg('קבוצה_מליאה',24)+' קבוצתי')+'</span>':'';inner='<div class="brow-inner"><div class="brow-label">'+a.name+(m?'&nbsp;&nbsp;'+modeHtml:'')+'</div><div class="brow-icons">'+mkImg(a.key,72,72)+'</div></div>';}else{inner='<div class="brow-inner" style="opacity:.3;min-height:60px;justify-content:center;"><div class="brow-label">—</div></div>';}}html+='<div class="brow'+(chk?' checked':'')+'" data-bi="'+slot+'"><div class="brow-bg" style="background-image:url(\''+(IMGS[bgKey]||'')+'\');background-color:'+bgColor+';"></div>'+inner+'<div class="done-ov">✓</div></div>';}html+='</div><div class="nav-row"><button type="button" class="btn btn-back" id="btnBack3">→ חזרה</button><button type="button" class="btn btn-reset" id="btnReset">🔄 התחל לוח חדש</button></div>';document.getElementById('content').innerHTML=html;document.querySelectorAll('.brow').forEach(function(row){function chkHandler(e){if(e.type==='touchend')e.preventDefault();var bi=parseInt(row.getAttribute('data-bi'));plan.checked[bi]=!plan.checked[bi];drawStep3();}row.addEventListener('touchend',chkHandler,{passive:false});row.addEventListener('click',chkHandler);});document.getElementById('btnBack3').addEventListener('touchend',function(e){e.preventDefault();goStep(2);},{passive:false});document.getElementById('btnBack3').addEventListener('click',function(){goStep(2);});document.getElementById('btnReset').addEventListener('touchend',function(e){e.preventDefault();resetAll();},{passive:false});document.getElementById('btnReset').addEventListener('click',function(){resetAll();});}
function resetAll(){plan={step:1,opening:[],acts:[],modes:{},checked:{}};goStep(1);}
function goStep(n){plan.step=n;drawSteps();if(n===1)drawStep1();else if(n===2)drawStep2();else drawStep3();window.scrollTo({top:0,behavior:'smooth'});}
goStep(1);
</script>
</body>
</html>
